TEXT.0: This file includes radio measurements recorded by the Wind/WAVES/RAD1 instrument. Time resolution varies with instrument mode ranging from few tenth of seconds to 192 seconds

Rules_of_use.0: Data provided are publicly available. If used in presentations or publications, please acknowledge Wind/Waves Investigation (Karine Issautier, PI). Please read carefully the caveats attached to the data. For reporting purposes, we request bibliography information for any publication, etc., using these data. Please send information on the use of this data to: Karine Issautier (PI).

Acknowledgement.0: Please acknowledge the Principal Investigators, Dr. Karine Issautier (LESIA, Observatoire de Paris-PSL, CNRS) and Keith Goetz (University of Minnesota)
